component.name: Z-Push
component.description: Z-Push source and deploy tree, including the JMAP backend; version from src/version. The tree is the upstream 2.7.x development line with the upstream 2.7.7 release merged in, plus local JMAP changes.

license.name: GNU AGPL version 3 with additional trademark terms

properties.name: inventory:license-evidence
properties.value: src/LICENSE contains the AGPL v3 text; src/include/z_RTF.php and other application headers state additional section 7 trademark terms. This license name does not describe the separate licenses of bundled third-party files.

properties.name: inventory:scope
properties.value: Source and deploy content under src/ at the recorded source tree; manually identified bundled code, not a complete file-by-file or license audit.

properties.name: inventory:limitations
properties.value: No lockfile, system, server, PHP runtime or installed deployment inventory is asserted. composer.json declares PHP >=7.4.0 but is not evidence of a bundled or installed PHP version. Presence does not establish runtime use or a complete dependency graph.

properties.name: inventory:versions
properties.value: PEAR references are upstream baselines explicitly cited in source headers, not versions of unmodified installed packages; local code is changed. Unknown versions are omitted.

components.name: Composer autoloader
components.description: Bundled Composer class loader and generated autoload files; Composer release version not established.

components.name: PEAR Mail_mimeDecode (modified source)
components.description: Locally modified MIME decoder; the upstream version is a reference implementation, not a verified package version of this code.

components.name: PEAR Mail_Mime mimePart (modified source)
components.description: Locally modified MIME part implementation, not the complete upstream package.

components.name: PEAR Mail (modified source)
components.description: Locally modified Mail interface, RFC822 parser and mail transport implementations; not an unmodified upstream package.

components.name: PEAR Auth_SASL (bundled source)
components.description: SASL implementations including locally modified files; the referenced release is not asserted for every file.
